args:
set -uo pipefail

ts=$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M)
work=/work
failed=0
done_count=0
label='wax100.io/pvc-backup=true'

# 前回が途中で止まったときの残り物を消す（一時ディスクとスナップショットの課金を止める）
cleanup_leftovers() {
  kubectl delete job -n infra -l "${label}" --ignore-not-found --timeout=5m
  kubectl delete pvc -n infra -l "${label}" --ignore-not-found --wait=false
  kubectl delete volumesnapshot -n infra -l "${label}" --ignore-not-found --timeout=5m
  kubectl delete volumesnapshotcontent -l "${label}" --ignore-not-found --timeout=5m
  kubectl get volumesnapshot -A -l "${label}" \
    -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace} {.metadata.name}{"\n"}{end}' \
    | while read -r ns name; do
        [ -n "${ns}" ] && kubectl delete volumesnapshot -n "${ns}" "${name}" --ignore-not-found --timeout=5m
      done
}

# 1 つの PVC の後片付け（成功・失敗どちらでも呼ぶ）
cleanup_one() {
  local ns=$1 name=$2
  kubectl delete job -n infra "${name}" --ignore-not-found --timeout=5m
  kubectl delete pvc -n infra "${name}" --ignore-not-found --wait=false
  kubectl delete volumesnapshot -n infra "${name}" --ignore-not-found --timeout=5m
  # Retain なので、これを消しても元のスナップショットは消えない
  kubectl delete volumesnapshotcontent "${name}" --ignore-not-found --timeout=5m
  # ここで GCE のスナップショットが消える（VolumeSnapshotClass が Delete）
  kubectl delete volumesnapshot -n "${ns}" "${name}" --ignore-not-found --timeout=5m
} > /dev/null

wait_ready() {
  kubectl wait -n "$1" "volumesnapshot/$2" \
    --for=jsonpath='{.status.readyToUse}'=true --timeout=30m > /dev/null
}

backup_one() {
  local ns=$1 pvc=$2 sc=$3 name=$4 content handle size state

  # 1. アプリの Namespace でスナップショット
  kubectl create -f - <<EOF || return 1
apiVersion: snapshot.storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: VolumeSnapshot
metadata:
  name: ${name}
  namespace: ${ns}
  labels: {wax100.io/pvc-backup: "true"}
spec:
  volumeSnapshotClassName: pvc-backup
  source: {persistentVolumeClaimName: ${pvc}}
EOF
  wait_ready "${ns}" "${name}" || { echo "ERROR: スナップショットが用意できません"; return 1; }
  content=$(kubectl get volumesnapshot -n "${ns}" "${name}" -o jsonpath='{.status.boundVolumeSnapshotContentName}')
  size=$(kubectl get volumesnapshot -n "${ns}" "${name}" -o jsonpath='{.status.restoreSize}')
  handle=$(kubectl get volumesnapshotcontent "${content}" -o jsonpath='{.status.snapshotHandle}')
  [ -n "${handle}" ] && [ -n "${size}" ] || { echo "ERROR: スナップショットの情報を読めません"; return 1; }

  # 2. 同じスナップショットを infra に取り込み、一時ディスクを作る
  kubectl create -f - <<EOF || return 1
apiVersion: snapshot.storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: VolumeSnapshotContent
metadata:
  name: ${name}
  labels: {wax100.io/pvc-backup: "true"}
spec:
  deletionPolicy: Retain
  driver: pd.csi.storage.gke.io
  volumeSnapshotClassName: pvc-backup
  source: {snapshotHandle: "${handle}"}
  volumeSnapshotRef: {name: ${name}, namespace: infra}
---
apiVersion: snapshot.storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: VolumeSnapshot
metadata:
  name: ${name}
  namespace: infra
  labels: {wax100.io/pvc-backup: "true"}
spec:
  volumeSnapshotClassName: pvc-backup
  source: {volumeSnapshotContentName: ${name}}
EOF
  wait_ready infra "${name}" || { echo "ERROR: infra へのスナップショットの取り込みに失敗しました"; return 1; }

  kubectl create -f - <<EOF || return 1
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ${name}
  namespace: infra
  labels: {wax100.io/pvc-backup: "true"}
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  $( [ "${sc}" != "-" ] && echo "storageClassName: ${sc}" )
  resources: {requests: {storage: "${size}"}}
  dataSource:
    apiGroup: snapshot.storage.k8s.io
    kind: VolumeSnapshot
    name: ${name}
EOF

  # 3. 一時ディスクを読み取り専用でマウントして restic で送る
  kubectl create -f - <<EOF || return 1
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: ${name}
  namespace: infra
  labels: {wax100.io/pvc-backup: "true"}
spec:
  backoffLimit: 0
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 10800
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: pvc-backup-mover, wax100.io/pvc-backup: "true"}
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      serviceAccountName: pvc-backup-mover
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      nodeSelector: {workload-type: platform}
      tolerations:
        - {key: cloud.google.com/gke-spot, operator: Equal, value: "true", effect: NoSchedule}
      containers:
        - name: restic
          image: ${MOVER_IMAGE}
          command: [restic]
          args: [backup, --host, pvc-backup, --tag, pvc, --tag, "${ns}", --exclude, lost+found, "/pvc/${ns}/${pvc}"]
          env:
            - {name: RESTIC_REPOSITORY, value: "${RESTIC_REPOSITORY}"}
            - {name: RESTIC_REST_USERNAME, value: backup}
            - {name: RESTIC_REST_PASSWORD, valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: restic-client, key: RESTIC_REST_PASSWORD}}}
            - {name: RESTIC_PASSWORD, valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: restic-client, key: RESTIC_PASSWORD}}}
            - {name: RESTIC_CACHE_DIR, value: /cache}
          # 持ち主やパーミッションに関わらず読むために root で DAC_READ_SEARCH だけを持つ
          securityContext:
            runAsUser: 0
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities: {drop: [ALL], add: [DAC_READ_SEARCH]}
          resources:
            requests: {cpu: 100m, memory: 256Mi}
            limits: {memory: 2Gi}
          volumeMounts:
            - {name: data, mountPath: "/pvc/${ns}/${pvc}", readOnly: true}
            - {name: cache, mountPath: /cache}
            - {name: tmp, mountPath: /tmp}
      volumes:
        - {name: data, persistentVolumeClaim: {claimName: ${name}, readOnly: true}}
        - {name: cache, emptyDir: {sizeLimit: 5Gi}}
        - {name: tmp, emptyDir: {sizeLimit: 1Gi}}
EOF

  # 完了か失敗まで待つ（Job 側の期限は 3 時間）
  while :; do
    state=$(kubectl get job -n infra "${name}" -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[?(@.status=="True")].type}') || return 1
    case " ${state} " in
      *" Complete "*) kubectl logs -n infra "job/${name}" --tail=6; return 0 ;;
      *" Failed "*) kubectl logs -n infra "job/${name}" --tail=20; return 1 ;;
    esac
    sleep 15
  done
}

cleanup_leftovers > /dev/null 2>&1

# ---- 対象を決める: "<OK|NOCSI|UNBOUND> <ns> <pvc> <storageClass か ->" ----
kubectl get pvc -A -o json > "${work}/pvcs.json" \
  && kubectl get pods -A -o json > "${work}/pods.json" \
  && kubectl get pv -o json > "${work}/pvs.json" \
  || { echo "ERROR: PVC / Pod / PV の一覧を取れませんでした"; exit 1; }

targets=$(ruby -rjson -rset -e '
  db = %r{(?:\A|/)(?:library/)?(postgres|mysql|mariadb)[:@]}
  load = ->(f) { JSON.parse(File.read(f))["items"] }
  pvs = load.("'"${work}"'/pvs.json").to_h { |pv| [pv["metadata"]["name"], pv] }
  db_claims = Set.new
  load.("'"${work}"'/pods.json").each do |pod|
    next unless (pod.dig("spec", "containers") || []).any? { |c| c["image"].to_s.match?(db) }
    (pod.dig("spec", "volumes") || []).each do |v|
      cn = v.dig("persistentVolumeClaim", "claimName")
      db_claims << "#{pod["metadata"]["namespace"]}/#{cn}" if cn
    end
  end
  load.("'"${work}"'/pvcs.json").each do |pvc|
    m = pvc["metadata"]
    ns = m["namespace"]
    next unless ns.start_with?("prod-")
    flag = m.dig("annotations", "wax100.io/backup")
    next if flag == "false"
    next if db_claims.include?("#{ns}/#{m["name"]}") && flag != "true"
    sc = pvc.dig("spec", "storageClassName").to_s
    sc = "-" if sc.empty?
    state =
      if pvc.dig("status", "phase") != "Bound" then "UNBOUND"
      elsif pvs.dig(pvc.dig("spec", "volumeName"), "spec", "csi", "driver") != "pd.csi.storage.gke.io" then "NOCSI"
      else "OK"
      end
    puts [state, ns, m["name"], sc].join(" ")
  end
') || { echo "ERROR: 対象を決められませんでした"; exit 1; }

while read -r state ns pvc sc; do
  [ -n "${ns}" ] || continue
  echo "== ${ns}/${pvc}"
  case "${state}" in
    UNBOUND) echo "skip: まだディスクが割り当てられていません"; continue ;;
    NOCSI)   echo "ERROR: Persistent Disk（CSI）ではないのでスナップショットを取れません"; failed=1; continue ;;
  esac
  # 名前は 63 文字以内に収める（Job 名とラベルの上限）
  name="pvcb-$(printf '%s/%s' "${ns}" "${pvc}" | sha1sum | cut -c1-10)-${ts}"
  if backup_one "${ns}" "${pvc}" "${sc}" "${name}" < /dev/null; then
    echo "ok: /pvc/${ns}/${pvc}"
    done_count=$((done_count + 1))
  else
    echo "ERROR: ${ns}/${pvc} を送れませんでした"
    failed=1
  fi
  cleanup_one "${ns}" "${name}" < /dev/null
done <<< "${targets}"

echo "完了: ${done_count} 件"
exit "${failed}"
containers.name: pvc-backup
